problem_repair: THE ORIGINAL BROWSER RECOVERY SUITE REPEATS THE GOAL STRING AT STAGE2, SO IT DOES NOT PROVE MEMORY-ASSISTED RECOVERY. THIS WITNESS STORES THE STAGE1 GOAL IN BRAIN-OWNED CAPSULE STATE, DELIBERATELY DISCARDS THE EVALUATOR'S STAGE2 GOAL, AND RECONSTRUCTS THE CANDIDATE INPUT ONLY FROM CAPSULE MEMORY.
case_semantics: STAGE1 GOAL IS CONTENT-BOUND INTO BRAIN-OWNED CAPSULE STATE.
THE ORIGINAL FROZEN BROWSER HIDDEN-ORACLE SUITE FORCES A STALE RENDER IDENTITY BEFORE STAGE2.
AT STAGE2 THE WRAPPER DISCARDS THE REPEATED EVALUATOR GOAL AND PROJECTS browser.goal FROM CAPSULE MEMORY.
THE EXISTING BROWSER CANDIDATE MUST RE-GROUND TO THE NEW ELEMENT ID AND BIND THE STALE-STATE RECEIPT.
CAUSAL ABLATION REPLACES THE CAPSULE WITH AN EMPTY CAPSULE BEFORE STAGE2; THE SAME CASE MUST FAIL.

classification.tournament_effect: REMOVE BROWSER_MEMORY_RECOVERY FROM NEW IMPLEMENTATION FRONTIER IF THE EXACT PREEXPOSURE BYTES EXECUTE SUCCESSFULLY.
